name: VOD Preferences
description: Greater control over which VOD stream Dispatcharr serves for a given title: prefer higher video/audio qualities across providers, remember preferred streams for specific titles, and more.
author: andyj682

fields.label: Prefer quality
fields.help_text: Sets the highest video quality to prefer. Quality is inferred from actual video pixel dimensions, explicit quality/resolution, provider stream name, the category's quality tag (if you set one), and M3U account name (e.g., a '4K' provider), in that order. A chosen tier wins when available; otherwise lower priorities are tried before higher ones in descending order. Streams with no quality signal keep their native account-priority order. Precise wherever measured resolution exists (most TV, and movies enriched by a probing plugin); for movies with no measurements, a tagged category or a '4K' label in the stream name is what tells copies apart.

fields.label: Remember my UI pick
fields.help_text: Save a specific stream played from the Dispatcharr UI as the default so the proxy serves it next time. Movies remember the exact stream; TV remembers the PROVIDER for the whole series. Applied ahead of the quality rule; dropped automatically if the provider stops carrying the title.

fields.label: Prefer better audio (tiebreaker)
fields.help_text: Among streams of the same video quality, prefer higher-quality audio (5.1/7.1 -> 2.0, and within each category lossless -> Dolby -> AAC -> other). Streams with no readable audio info keep their native order.

fields.label: Avoid Dolby Vision without HDR/SDR fallback
fields.help_text: Demote Dolby Vision streams with no HDR10/SDR base layer (Profile 5) to lowest priority to avoid playback compatibility issues. Leave off if your players handle Profile 5 fine.

fields.label: Avoid low-bitrate copies
fields.help_text: Within the same video quality, rank a copy whose video bitrate is below the minimum for its tier (settings below) after the healthy copies, and let a clearly higher bitrate break any remaining tie. Bitrates are compared as H.264-equivalent (HEVC/AV1 count 1.5x). Never moves a copy across quality tiers; copies with no bitrate info are never demoted. Takes effect only when Prefer quality is set.

fields.label: Minimum bitrate, 4K (Mbps)
fields.help_text: H.264-equivalent video Mbps below which a 4K copy counts as low-bitrate. 0 turns this tier's minimum off. Default 6.

fields.label: Title key to clear
fields.placeholder: e.g. tmdb:954  (or a bare tmdb/imdb id)
fields.help_text: Type the key of a saved pick here (copy it from 'List saved picks'), then click 'Clear one'. Leave blank otherwise.

fields.label: Recent play # to avoid
fields.help_text: Which entry from 'List recent plays' the 'Avoid copy' button marks as a bad copy (1 = the most recent). TV: avoids that provider for the show. Movies: avoids that exact copy. An avoided copy is served only if nothing else can play.

fields.label: Avoid just that season (TV)
fields.help_text: When on, a TV avoid rule covers only the season of the episode you picked instead of the whole show. Ignored for movies.

fields.label: Avoid rule # to remove
fields.help_text: The number shown by 'List avoid rules', for the 'Remove rule' button.

fields.label: Notify on missed 4K
fields.help_text: Send an alert when a title plays below 4K because its only 4K copy is Dolby Vision without an HDR/SDR fallback. Needs Prefer 4K and the Dolby Vision setting on, plus a Prowl key or webhook below. At most one alert per title per day.

fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help_text: Optional. Receives a JSON POST with title, message, text and content fields (works with Slack/Discord-style webhooks, Home Assistant and similar).

fields.description: Selection order (most specific first): explicit request pick -> saved UI pick -> avoid DV without fallback -> avoid rules -> quality tier -> avoid low bitrate -> audio -> bitrate -> native account priority. Use the buttons below to inspect or clear saved picks and avoid rules.

actions.label: Show patch status
actions.description: Report whether the preferences patch is active in the workers that serve streams, plus current settings.

actions.label: List saved picks
actions.description: Show the remembered per-title stream picks.

actions.label: Clear one saved pick
actions.description: Remove the saved pick whose key is in the 'Title key to clear' box.

actions.label: Clear all saved picks
actions.description: Remove every remembered per-title stream pick.

confirm.title: Clear all saved picks?
confirm.message: This permanently removes every remembered per-title stream pick. Quality preferences are unaffected.

actions.label: List recent plays
actions.description: Show the last 5 titles the proxy served, with the provider each one played from.

actions.label: Avoid a recent play
actions.description: Mark the copy from 'Recent play # to avoid' as bad, so it is served only as a last resort.

actions.label: List avoid rules
actions.description: Show the copies and providers you've marked to avoid.

actions.label: Remove an avoid rule
actions.description: Remove the rule numbered in 'Avoid rule # to remove'.

confirm.title: Clear all avoid rules?
confirm.message: This permanently removes every avoid rule. Saved picks and quality preferences are unaffected.

actions.label: Send test notification
actions.description: Send a test alert to the Prowl key and/or webhook in Settings.
